title: Bridging the Language Gap in Scholarly Data II: Enhancing Gender Inference for Chinese Names

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the accuracy, information loss, and exclusion (unclassified) rates of commercial gender inference tools and LLMs when processing non-Western Chinese names in Romanized (Pinyin) versus logographic (Hanzi) scripts.

Evaluating the models' precision and recall in predicting male, female, and neutral perceived genders, specifically identifying systematic misgendering and the tendency to force binary gender labels onto gender-neutral names.
